text:
maria.s: @channel Need to reserve GPUs in asia-east1 for the new cluster bring-up. Pilot: 4xA100 (40GB) nodes for initial tests, then scale to 16. Who can open quota requests and confirm procurement timeline? We need capacity reserved for 72 hours window around the bring-up.

alex_k: I can take the quota request. Is this going on GCP or partner colo? If GCP, we should request both CPUs and GPUs; quota requests can take 24-72h.

samir: It's GCP. We should also create a capacity reservation (zonal) after quota is approved. Reminder: asia-east1 has low spare A100s this month, might need fallback to asia-southeast1.

maria.s: Good point. Priority order: asia-east1 -> asia-southeast1. If east1 can't commit, we want pre-approved plan to fall back. Can someone draft the procurement email/template?

alex_k: Drafted, copying template below:

`````
Subject: Quota increase and capacity reservation request — project: redwood-prod
Body:
- Region: asia-east1
- Resource: GPUs (A100 40GB) - initial 4 -> target 16 over 2 weeks
- CPUs: 64
- Requesting quota increase and advice on capacity reservation for 72h bring-up window
- Preferred start: 2026-04-02 UTC
- Contact: alex.k@redwood.com, +1-555-0102
`````

samir: Also add: we need service-account tag for billing project and mention committed use discount interest (we may do 6mo if utilization justifies). Cost estimate: ~ $6.5/hr per A100 -> 4 nodes @48 GPU-hours/day ~ $1,248/day for pilot (ballpark).

kai: I'll open the GCP console ticket now and ping support. Also creating a CReservation after quota. Command to validate once quota is granted:

`gcloud compute reservations create bringup-res --project=redwood-prod --zone=asia-east1-a --accelerator-type=a100 --accelerator-count=4 --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --commitment-end=2026-04-05T00:00:00Z`

maria.s: Checklist for bring-up (validation + handoff):
- quota approved & reservation created
- nodes spin up and join k8s: `kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true`
- run perf smoke: `python infra/tests/gpu_smoke.py --iters 10`
- confirm network egress rules to object-store and model registry
- alerting created for GPU OOMs and headroom
- handoff doc in Confluence + notify SRE oncall

infra-bot: [automated] Created ticket #GC-7842 for quota increase. ETA 48h. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas

alex_k: Opening ticket now. Adding fallback clause to allow asia-southeast1 pre-approval. Also tagging procurement for contract approval.

maria.s: Thanks. After quota/reservation is confirmed, schedule the prep window and I'll run the validation. If support says >72h we should consider reserving preemptible capacity parallel and shift traffic.

kai: FYI I confirmed spare inventory with partner colo in asia-southeast, but need procurement ok for colo racks — longer lead time.

samir: Noted. If we can't get A100s in region, we can consider mixing with A40s and add quantization recommendation from ML team.

alex_k: I'll update the ticket and post updates here. :thumbsup:

maria.s: Great. Thanks everyone — please ping here when reservation is live.
